name: Animated Content
description: Wrapper that animates any children into view with a slide, fade, scale, blur, rotate, tilt or mask wipe, triggered on scroll or mount, with optional stagger, scrub and exit.
contents: A single div wrapper that renders the children passed in, hidden until its animation is set up
behavior: Children slide in from a distance along the vertical or horizontal axis while fading, scaling, blurring, rotating or tilting to rest
Plays when the wrapper reaches the scroll threshold, or immediately on mount
With stagger above 0, each direct child animates in sequence
Optional mask wipe reveals content from up, down, left, right or center
With scrub, the animation follows scroll position instead of playing on its own
With once false, the animation reverses when scrolling back above the trigger
With disappearAfter above 0, content animates out after finishing (only when once is true and scrub is off)
Skips the animation and shows content at once when the user prefers reduced motion
editableByProps: Direction, distance, reverse, duration, ease, delay
Fade, scale, blur, rotate and tilt amounts
Scroll threshold, trigger mode, once, scrub and custom scroll container
Callbacks, className, style and extra div attributes

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the exit scale or direction

needsCodeEdit.where: end value in the scrub branch of ScrollTrigger.create

fixed: Requires gsap and its ScrollTrigger plugin, registered globally at module load
Wrapper is hidden with the invisible class until the effect runs, so content stays hidden if JavaScript fails
Without a container prop, uses the element with id snap-main-container as scroller if present, otherwise the window
Inline transform, filter and mask styles are cleared after the animation finishes, except in scrub mode
Exit animation always scales to 0.8 and moves opposite to the entry direction
Wipe fade edge is a fixed 40 percent soft gradient
Scrub range ends 45 percentage points of viewport above the start
Changing most animation props re-creates the animation
